moments.title: Dolly Parton's Chart Resurgence
moments.blurb: Following her passing on August 25, three Dolly Parton classics are high on the UK Official Singles Chart this week, with '9 to 5' at #5 and 'Jolene' at #6.

angles.name: Chart Topper Tribute
angles.copy: Dolly Parton's legacy lives on in the charts! Her iconic '9 to 5' is at #5 and 'Jolene' at #6 this week. What's your favourite Dolly track?

angles.name: Timeless Hits
angles.copy: Amazing to see Dolly Parton's timeless hits still dominating the UK charts. A true testament to an icon. Tune in for more classic hits.

moments.title: Autumn Equinox Approaching
moments.blurb: The astronomical Autumnal Equinox, marking the official start of autumn in the Northern Hemisphere, occurs on Wednesday, September 23, 2026, at 01:05 BST.

angles.name: Hello Autumn
angles.copy: The days are drawing in! The Autumnal Equinox, marking the official start of astronomical autumn, is just two weeks away on September 23rd.

angles.name: Seasonal Shift
angles.copy: While meteorological autumn started September 1st, the astronomical Autumnal Equinox arrives on September 23rd. Time to embrace those cosy vibes!
